combo1.title: Pumpking's Eldlich Splash into The Undying Legion
combo1.description:
A one-card Pumpking opening that snowballs into the deck's full Eldlich package. Pumpking discards itself as the reveal cost to Set Call of the Haunted, then the Trap revives it immediately, netting Changshi the Spiridao from the Deck and milling Army of the Haunted and Eldlich the Golden Lord along the way.

Overlaying Pumpking and Changshi into Officiator of Doom Samuel restocks Changshi from the Graveyard, which lets Army of the Haunted Special Summon itself off its own trigger — fueling a Rank-Up into Pumpking the Great Ghost King. Ghost King's on-field effects mill Stare of the Snake Hair and bounce Delta of Invitation back to hand.

Eldlich the Golden Lord revives itself by sending a Call of the Haunted to the Graveyard as cost, then tributes itself to Fusion Summon Fallen Angel of the Golden Land. Call of the Forgotten Sets two more copies of Call of the Haunted from the Deck before the turn closes on an Xyz Summon of The Undying Legion — leaving a Fusion monster, a Rank 7 boss, a live Field Spell, and a fresh trap line all in play.

combo2.title: Pumpking to Eldlich Control Sequence
combo2.description: An explosive line showcasing the synergy between Pumpking the King of Grave Ghosts and the Eldlich package. The sequence begins by discarding Pumpking to set Call of the Haunted, instantly reviving it to swarm the field with Changshi the Spiridao. By utilizing Xyz plays into Officiator of Doom Samuel and Pumpking the Great Ghost King, the graveyard is heavily stocked, allowing Eldlich the Golden Lord to emerge and extend into Fallen Angel of the Golden Land.
